_comment: Saved by the tls-peek UI. program: .exe to monitor. host_filter: optional plain domain like api.example.com (empty = all traffic). ui_port: port of the UI. auto_stop_seconds: stop when no UI tab polled for this long; closing the last tab stops after 10 s (0 = never). keep_days: captures older than this are deleted (0 = keep all).
